subject: ela
intro: Compare a text to its multimedia version.

items.prompt:
A video of a speech adds the speaker's:
A) voice, emotion, and delivery
B) page numbers
C) a glossary

steps: Video's unique add. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Documentary footage of a storm mainly:
A) makes the event vivid and real
B) adds a table of contents
C) hides the event
items.answer: A) makes the event vivid and real

steps: Visuals are vivid. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) makes the event vivid and real

items.prompt:
A written article can provide more ____ than a short clip.
A) detail and background
B) sound
C) lighting

You read a speech, then watch it delivered to a cheering crowd. The video adds:
A) the speaker's emotion and the audience's reaction
B) nothing new
C) only the words
items.answer: A) the speaker's emotion and the audience's reaction

solution.answer: A) the speaker's emotion and the audience's reaction

items.prompt:
A speaker's TONE of voice in an audio version:
A) can change the impact of the words
B) never matters
C) removes meaning
items.answer: A) can change the impact of the words

steps: Delivery shapes impact. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) can change the impact of the words

items.prompt:
Which can a TEXT do better than a short video?
A) give careful detail and background
B) show live footage
C) play music
items.answer: A) give careful detail and background

steps: Text is detailed. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) give careful detail and background

items.prompt:
A documentary adds dramatic music and slow-motion footage to a news story about a rescue. These techniques:
A) shape the viewer's emotions in ways the plain text did not
B) make the story less clear
C) only waste time
items.answer: A) shape the viewer's emotions in ways the plain text did not

steps: Media techniques add emotion. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) shape the viewer's emotions in ways the plain text did not

items.prompt:
When comparing a written text to its multimedia version, a careful analyst asks:
A) how each medium portrays the subject and what each adds or emphasizes
B) only which is shorter
C) only the title
items.answer: A) how each medium portrays the subject and what each adds or emphasizes

steps: Compare the portrayals. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) how each medium portrays the subject and what each adds or emphasizes
